correctness.rationale: Global sign rescales all columns; translating the window shifts all time indices; coordinate reversal conjugates both indices by negation with a common invertible row permutation. In the stated indexing k=7a+b, independent generation of all 128 literal words and dihedral orbits modulo sign recovers exactly the nine table rows and the 64 normalized sizes. Checked the literal RESULT table columns for range and distinctness and recomputed each minor by dynamic last-row Laplace expansion in ℤ[z]/(z^7−1), not by the uploaded permutation code or finite-field rank. The entire coefficient vector is zero for each witness, so specialization z=ω proves complex singularity. Symmetry covers every sign window. These are frames (one fixed time coordinate and all seven modulations already form a nonsingular Fourier basis after nonzero diagonal scaling), but not full spark.
